result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the module compiles offline. I could not run the jar, so the dispatch and help output are checked by reading the code, not by execution.

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in `usageInfo()` with the same landscape options, so the no-argument overview shows it.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` sends both names to `updateLandscape`, so options and behaviour are identical. In the `-help` branch, `analyzeLandscape -help` prints its own name and description; `updateLandscape -help` prints the same usage as before.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape report" section showing `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` and noting that `updateLandscape` is kept as an alias.

The cli module has no tests. Running the jar was blocked by the sandbox, so please check `java -jar cli/target/cli-1.0-jar-with-dependencies.jar analyzeLandscape -help` after rebuilding. I did not commit.
